title: Control Action Response
description: Response of the control endpoints for one application of the node named in the X-Remote-Everything-Node header: GET /__remote_everything/apps/:id/status, POST /__remote_everything/apps/:id/start and POST /__remote_everything/apps/:id/stop. A node that cannot be reached is answered with ok=false, code=computer_offline and HTTP 200, not as an HTTP error: the two are different things and a client shows them differently.

action.description: The action that was requested, which is the endpoint that was called.

computer_connected.description: Whether the gateway can reach the node.

app.description: Full app state, present only when computer is connected.

error_code.description: Error code present only when ok=false and a specific failure reason exists.
